issue.title: v3.3.0 broke expand=True
issue.body:
While trying to figure out our sudden broken OCSP because of caldav depending on niquests (https://github.com/jawah/niquests/issues/475) I updated caldav and ran into an independent issue. For us v3.3.0 and newer broke the `expand=True`. I was following the "reoccuring events" issues here and once had expand='client' but then we had to change to `expand=True`. However, `expand=True` is broken in v3.3.0 but still working in v3.2.1. It simply looks to me that expansion doesn't happen at all, the first calendar entry is there (master), then nothing. I couldn't find any documentation around that here. I asked the large lying machines for help and it sent my 10 wrong directions, then suddenly: compatibility_workarounds=False.

So the only way to make the entire thing work again was to do multiple things at once: add `compatibility_workarounds=False` as a flag for calendar.search, pin version to 3.3.1a0 at the same time and then tell all my tech users to manually do a `pip uninstall qh3` (good luck trying to specify that uninstall in a pyproject.toml!).

That was a very painful experience. Feel free to close this issue, but I just wanted the next poor bastard to be a little more lucky with his search.

expected.cause: Since v3.3.0 a search without a component type is split into one query per component type in caldav/search.py, and the merged results are deduplicated by URL only, which collapses all expanded occurrences of a recurring event (they share one URL) into the first; the fix deduplicates on URL plus RECURRENCE-ID.
